summary: Implemented GeneralizedWassersteinDiceLoss in monai/losses/dice.py (class after GeneralizedDiceLoss, plus generalized_wasserstein_dice alias; numpy and torch functional imports added). Exported the class from monai/losses/__init__.py. Added tests/test_generalized_wasserstein_dice_loss.py with the binary 2D and empty-class tests. Nothing was run and nothing was committed. Not covered by tests: the batch-coupling case (expected 0.333, hand-checked as TP 0.8 and D 2.4 per sample), numpy-vs-tensor equivalence, max-normalization, and reduction invariance.
